subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: Should WhatsApp call activity be exposed only as transient sanitized events, or persisted as durable per-contact history for reminder workflows?
rationale: Transient event delivery and durable relationship history have materially different privacy, identity, retention, deduplication, storage, migration, deletion, and public API requirements that cannot be selected safely from implementation details alone.

options.title: Transient Events Only
options.body: Add opt-in sanitized call-status events inside the WhatsApp plugin without retaining per-contact call history.

options.title: Durable Contact History
options.body: First design a canonical SQLite activity model with identity resolution, retention, migration, deletion, and user-control contracts.

options.title: Decline Call Tracking
options.body: Leave Baileys call metadata unconsumed if the privacy and long-term maintenance costs exceed the optional reminder value.

recommendation.title: Transient Events Only
recommendation.body: Add opt-in sanitized call-status events inside the WhatsApp plugin without retaining per-contact call history.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent WhatsApp calling, session maintenance, and issue-scoping history make this the strongest available owner for the product and privacy boundary decision.
